description: Delete a signal; returns { deleted: true }. Its checks stop immediately. Events it already produced stay available in get_signal_events until their 90 days run out. To watch the target of a stopped signal again, delete it and create it again with create_signal. Fails with signalNotFound for an unknown id.

signalId.description: Signal id, as returned by create_signal or get_signals.

name: delete_signal
